The RMS is a statistical measure that represents the square root of the mean of the squared values of a set of numbers. It's essentially a measure of the magnitude of a varying quantity.

Given the MLII signal values for record_id 106, we will calculate the RMS step by step.

1. **Extract MLII Values**: Extract all MLII values for record_id 106 from the provided data.
